stories.title: 多国前政要学者参访浙江温州 看好中国经济韧性

en.title: Former officials and scholars from multiple countries visit Wenzhou, Zhejiang
en.summary: More than a dozen former government officials and academics from seven countries visited Wenzhou, Zhejiang on October 9-10. Several visitors expressed optimism about China's economic resilience and continued development.

stories.title: Taiwanese leader welcomes talks between Washington and Beijing ‘to reduce risk of war’

en.title: Taiwanese leader welcomes talks between Washington and Beijing 'to reduce risk of war'
en.summary: Taiwan's leader William Lai Ching-te expressed support for discussions between the United States and China aimed at reducing conflict risk. In his Double Tenth address, Lai also urged democracies to strengthen cooperation for regional stability and called for respect of Taiwan's right to exist.

stories.title: （经济观察）勿将贸易账算在汇率上 人民币涨跌由市场决定

en.title: (Economic Watch) Do Not Attribute Trade Accounts to Exchange Rates; Renminbi Fluctuations Determined by Market
en.summary: The People's Bank of China released its policy position on the renminbi exchange rate, emphasizing that the rate is determined by market supply and demand, and China does not intend to gain trade advantages through currency depreciation.

stories.title: 冷空气登场局地降温将超8℃ 为何南方多地热感不减反增？

en.title: Cold air arrives with temperature drops exceeding 8℃ in some areas; why does heat sensation increase rather than decrease in many southern regions?
en.summary: Heavy rainfall in Hainan is ending while precipitation increases over the next three days across northwestern, northern, and northeastern regions. Rainfall in some areas of Sichuan and Shaanxi may be heavy, though northern regions will experience lighter precipitation with limited moisture conditions.

stories.title: 别把青少年抑郁当“叛逆”，专家提醒这些信号要注意

en.title: Don't Mistake Adolescent Depression for "Rebelliousness," Experts Warn of These Warning Signs
en.summary: Mental health experts caution that depression in teenagers often manifests as irritability, school avoidance, and refusal to attend classes, symptoms frequently misidentified as typical rebelliousness. Early intervention during adolescence is critical to prevent these issues from persisting into adulthood and affecting work performance and relationships.

stories.title: Hong Kong records 21 mpox cases since August, high-risk groups urged to get jabs

en.title: Hong Kong records 21 mpox cases since August, high-risk groups urged to get jabs
en.summary: Hong Kong has recorded 21 mpox cases since August, representing 70 percent of this year's total cases. Health authorities are encouraging people engaged in high-risk sexual contact to seek vaccination and other protective measures to reduce infection risk.

stories.title: 紧盯人工智能、数字经济 “十五五”时期将开发培育更多新职业

en.title: Focusing on artificial intelligence and digital economy, more new occupations will be developed and cultivated during the '15th Five-Year Plan' period
en.summary: China's human resources and social security department outlined plans to develop new job categories in artificial intelligence and the digital economy sector during the upcoming 15th Five-Year Plan period.

stories.title: Retired China Olympic champion diver sparks debate after reality show reveals toxic parenting

en.title: Retired China Olympic champion diver sparks debate after reality show reveals toxic parenting
en.summary: Zhang Jiaqi, a 22-year-old retired Chinese Olympic diving champion who won gold in the Tokyo 2020 synchronised 10-metre platform event, appeared on a reality TV show that highlighted her mother's controlling behaviour, prompting online criticism and discussion about parenting practices.

stories.title: 驻澳大使就澳大利亚知名汉学家马克林教授逝世表示深切哀悼

en.title: Chinese Ambassador Expresses Deep Condolences Over Passing of Australian Sinologist Professor Mackerras
en.summary: Australian renowned sinologist Professor Mackerras died in Brisbane on October 8. China's ambassador to Australia expressed deep condolences and sincere sympathy to his family on October 10.

stories.title: 江西省财政厅原巡视员潘昌坤接受审查调查

en.title: Former Inspector of Jiangxi Provincial Finance Department Pan Changyun Under Investigation
en.summary: Pan Changyun, former inspector of Jiangxi Province's finance department, is under disciplinary review and investigation by provincial authorities for suspected serious violations of regulations and law.

stories.title: 中国海警舰艇编队10月10日在我钓鱼岛及其附属岛屿领海内维权巡航

en.title: China Coast Guard Flotilla Conducts Rights Protection Patrol in Diaoyu Islands Waters on October 10
en.summary: China Coast Guard's Xiamen flotilla conducted a rights protection patrol in waters around the Diaoyu Islands and affiliated islands on October 10 as part of regular law enforcement activities.

en.title: Deputy General Manager Chen Zhiliang of Gansu Provincial Construction Investment Group Under Investigation
en.summary: Chen Zhiliang, deputy general manager and party committee member of Gansu Provincial Construction Investment Group, is under disciplinary review and investigation for suspected serious violations of regulations and law.

stories.title: Better protection needed as violent cryptocurrency robberies surge

en.title: Better protection needed as violent cryptocurrency robberies surge
en.summary: Cryptocurrency holders face increasing risks from violent crime targeting their digital assets. The industry should develop products and services that address physical safety concerns alongside asset protection.

stories.title: Gen Z overtakes older collectors as art market spending rebounds globally: report

en.title: Gen Z overtakes older collectors as art market spending rebounds globally: report
en.summary: Younger wealthy collectors are now the art market's largest spenders, with expenditure more than double that of older generations. The global art market rebounded to approximately US$60 billion, driven partly by continued growth in mainland China and Hong Kong.

stories.title: China wants 5 innovative drugs with US$1 billion returns by 2030. Which might they be?

en.title: China wants 5 innovative drugs with US$1 billion returns by 2030. Which might they be?
en.summary: China has set a target to develop at least five pharmaceutical products generating over US$1 billion in annual global sales by 2030, as the country seeks to establish itself as a major biomedical power and compete with Western drug makers.

stories.title: K&K offers extra warranty to One Stanley homebuyers amid building defects furore

en.title: K&K offers extra warranty to One Stanley homebuyers amid building defects furore
en.summary: Developer K&K Property announced a six-year structural warranty for homeowners at its One Stanley luxury development in response to concerns about construction defects at the complex.

stories.title: Hong Kong outlines new liquidity reforms as US market rally pulls funds away

en.title: Hong Kong outlines new liquidity reforms as US market rally pulls funds away
en.summary: Hong Kong's securities regulator is implementing reforms to boost market liquidity, including extended trading hours and faster settlement cycles, as capital flows toward US equities and a stronger dollar pressure emerging markets.
